name: simple-justwatch-js
description: Unofficial JavaScript and TypeScript client for the public JustWatch GraphQL API.

scripts.test: node -e "const { SimpleJustWatch } = require('./'); const client = new SimpleJustWatch({ fetch: async () => ({ json: async () => ({ data: { providers: [] } }) }) }); if (!client || typeof client.search !== 'function') process.exit(1);"
scripts.test:live: node -e "const { SimpleJustWatch } = require('./'); (async () => { const jw = new SimpleJustWatch(); const search = await jw.search('The Matrix', { count: 1, objectTypes: ['MOVIE'] }); if (!search.edges?.[0]?.node?.title) throw new Error('search failed'); const details = await jw.details(search.edges[0].node.id); if (!details?.title) throw new Error('details failed'); const providers = await jw.providers(); if (!providers.length) throw new Error('providers failed'); })();"
